contracts.action: Move notifyOverridesChanged() from persistActive (before the switch commits) into the shared afterCommit hook
contracts.equivalent_path: persistActive in runSwitch refreshes the target's overrides (workspaceSettings.refresh) before commit; the notify now runs after the commit, alongside refreshTitles/broadcastState/broadcastLibraryChanged.
contracts.before_after: Before: listeners and windows were notified inside persistActive, before the switch was certain, so a later failure or abort could leave windows showing the target's settings. After: notification runs only once the transaction commits, and it also covers other transactions that share activeTransactionDeps (e.g. add and activate).
contracts.visible_effect: Windows get the new workspace's effective settings through the settings broadcast; notifyOverridesChanged skips the broadcast when the effective snapshot is unchanged.
contracts.failure_mode: If the refresh in persistActive throws, the switch fails and afterCommit does not run, so nothing is notified. The no-change case returns early without a broadcast.

structuredOutput.summary: I found nothing to flag in either file. The code change moves `notifyOverridesChanged()` out of `persistActive` and into the shared `afterCommit` hook. That means windows and main listeners hear about the new workspace's settings only after the switch has committed, instead of before it was certain. `notifyOverridesChanged` still returns early when the effective settings are unchanged, so no extra broadcast goes out. The doc change only moves three `settings:*` rows into the channel table. None of the open threads are on these two files, so I added no thread replies.
